_readme: Finger control for the 10-motor hands (O10). Motor positions are 0..4095.
Motor order per hand: thumb_rotation, thumb_wiggles, thumb_bent, index_wiggles, index_bent,
'open' is the pose with the trigger released, 'closed' the pose with the trigger fully pressed.
Only the motors of the selected fingers move between the two; all others stay at 'open'.
STATUS: the poses below are PROVISIONAL (taken from the vendor configuration, not yet checked
on the robot). Live finger control refuses to start until 'verified' is true.
